business.label: Business-Facing
business.note: Customer, revenue, and growth agents that touch subscribers and the top line directly.

fns.d: Correlates tickets with usage and history
Turns feedback into product and CX signals

agents.desc: Resolves 60–85% of routine inquiries across voice and chat, triages complex cases, and assists human agents with next-best-action prompts and auto-summaries.
agents.ch: High call volumes, long waits, and repetitive queries strain contact centres and inflate cost per contact.
agents.so: 24/7 self-service bots, intelligent triage that correlates tickets with usage and history, real-time agent assist, proactive churn detection, and 100% automated quality monitoring.
agents.ou: 30–50% lower cost per contact, 25–40% better first-contact resolution, 15–25% NPS improvement.

fns.d: Engages and scores inbound leads on intent
Generates complex B2B/B2C quotes to rules
Drives timely B2B renewals and upsell
Enables and scores indirect sales partners

agents.desc: Engages visitors 24/7, answers technical BSS/AAA questions, qualifies buyers on intent, generates complex quotes, and books meetings with account executives.
agents.ch: Manual lead qualification, slow quotes, and missed cross-sell opportunities cap revenue growth.
agents.so: Automated lead qualification, quote & deal automation with business rules, real-time cross-sell/upsell, and CRM enrichment — for both consumer and enterprise motions.
agents.ou: 3× lead-to-meeting conversion, 1–5% ARPU uplift, 20–30% faster sales cycles.

fns.d: Chooses the best action per subscriber
Runs points, tiers and win-back rewards

agents.desc: Runs hyper-personalised campaigns across SMS, app, email and USSD, optimises pricing and plans, and orchestrates churn-prevention journeys with multi-armed bandits.
agents.ch: Generic campaigns, suboptimal pricing, and reactive churn management limit marketing ROI.
agents.so: Behaviour-based segmentation, dynamic pricing and plan design, content automation at scale, early churn detection, and continuous offer optimisation.
agents.ou: 22% higher offer conversion, 10–25% churn reduction, 20–30% better marketing ROI.

fns.d: Answers bill questions in plain language
Smooths payments and cuts failed charges

agents.desc: Centralises billing data across systems to resolve disputes autonomously, detects revenue leakage and fraud patterns, and automates compliance reporting.
agents.ch: Billing disputes, revenue leakage, and compliance reporting consume large teams.
agents.so: Automated dispute resolution, leakage detection across charging and rating, fraud pattern recognition, automated compliance reporting, and self-healing billing.
agents.ou: 70% autonomous dispute resolution, 40–60% less leakage, 50% faster compliance reporting.

agents.desc: Handles employee HR/IT requests, processes invoices and expenses, drafts and reviews contracts, and orchestrates workflows across siloed internal systems.
agents.ch: Repetitive administrative work drains employee time across internal functions.
agents.so: HR & IT support automation, finance workflow automation, legal drafting and review, and cross-system orchestration end-to-end.
agents.ou: 50% fewer internal tickets, 30–50% productivity gains, 40% less manual data entry.

fns.d: Sells and upgrades in chat and app
Tailors the app home and offers per user

agents.desc: Runs the digital storefront and self-care journeys across app, web and chat — selling, onboarding and resolving without a human in the loop.
agents.ch: Customers want to buy and self-serve digitally, but fragmented app and web journeys push them back to costly assisted channels.
agents.so: Conversational commerce in app and chat, guided self-care journeys, digital onboarding and eSIM activation, app personalisation, and intelligent channel deflection.
agents.ou: 30–50% more digital sales, 25–40% lower call volume, 15–25% higher app satisfaction.

operations.label: Operations-Facing
operations.note: Assurance, fraud, experience, and partner agents that protect margin and quality at scale.

fns.d: Matches switch, billing and usage records
Assures inbound and outbound partner charges

agents.desc: Continuously reconciles switch, billing and usage data in real time, assures margins on B2B and wholesale contracts, and validates new offers before launch.
agents.ch: Leakage from unbilled usage, rating errors and partner disputes costs telcos 1–3% of annual revenue.
agents.so: Continuous anomaly detection, end-to-end lead-to-cash reconciliation, margin assurance, product & offer assurance, and self-healing billing.
agents.ou: 40–60% less leakage, 70% faster dispute resolution, 10–20% better wholesale margins.

fns.d: Scores voice, data and roaming traffic

agents.desc: Detects fraud across voice, data, roaming and messaging 24/7, investigates alerts autonomously, and blocks fraudulent traffic in milliseconds.
agents.ch: IRSF, SIM boxing, Wangiri, subscription and identity fraud cost the industry $38B+ annually.
agents.so: Real-time ML detection, autonomous investigation and correlation, automated response, plus specialised coverage for IRSF, SIM boxing, Wangiri, 5G slice abuse and OTT/tethering fraud.
agents.ou: 75% faster detection, 30–50% fraud-loss reduction, 40–60% less roaming fraud.

fns.d: Unifies CRM, billing, usage and QoS
Closes the loop on detractors automatically

agents.desc: Unifies CRM, billing, usage and network QoS into a 360° view, detects service degradation before customers complain, and orchestrates personalised journeys.
agents.ch: Subscribers expect proactive, seamless experiences, but legacy silos create inconsistent service.
agents.so: 360° customer view, proactive experience management, personalised journey orchestration, sentiment analysis, and self-service empowerment.
agents.ou: 15–25% NPS improvement, 20–30% fewer complaints, 20–35% more cross-sell revenue.

agents.desc: Monitors roaming traffic for fraud, automates settlement reconciliation across hundreds of agreements, and improves the traveller experience abroad.
agents.ch: Roaming means complex settlements, fraud risk, and cross-border experience challenges.
agents.so: Roaming fraud prevention, automated billing & settlements, partner performance analytics, proactive traveller experience, and roaming-intelligence APIs.
agents.ou: 40–60% less roaming fraud, 20–30% faster settlements, 15–20% higher roaming satisfaction.

fns.d: Keeps rate cards and deals current

agents.desc: Validates interconnect usage against contracts, detects bypass and pumping fraud, optimises routing, and automates multi-partner settlements.
agents.ch: Wholesale involves high-volume exchanges, complex pricing, margin pressure and partner fraud.
agents.so: Wholesale billing accuracy, margin optimisation, fraud detection, automated settlements, and contract-compliance monitoring.
agents.ou: 10–20% better wholesale margins, 50% fewer billing disputes, 15–25% faster partner onboarding.

fns.d: Scores applicants and sets limits in real time
Flags accounts likely to default early

agents.desc: Scores credit at onboarding, runs adaptive dunning, and recovers overdue balances — cutting bad debt while keeping collections compliant and customer-friendly.
agents.ch: Rising bad debt and blunt, one-size-fits-all dunning erode margin and frustrate otherwise good customers.
agents.so: Real-time credit scoring, adaptive dunning journeys, automated payment recovery and negotiation, early default prediction, and compliant collections.
agents.ou: 20–35% less bad debt, 15–25% higher recovery rates, 30% lower days-sales-outstanding.

foundational.label: Foundational
foundational.note: The data, integration, and platform agents every other agent is built on.

fns.d: Serves ML-ready features to every agent

agents.desc: Orchestrates real-time and batch ingestion from 50+ sources, applies telecom ontologies, automates data quality, and serves ML-ready features to every agent.
agents.ch: Operators generate petabytes daily, but data stays siloed, unstructured and underutilised.
agents.so: Unified ingestion, semantic modelling on TM Forum standards, automated data quality, feature-engineering automation, governed access, and NL self-service analytics.
agents.ou: 60–80% faster time-to-insight, 40–50% lower data-engineering cost, 3× more models deployed.

agents.desc: Resolves customer identities across systems, maintains a real-time golden record, automates stewardship, and activates enriched segments for marketing.
agents.ch: Fragmented identities across CRM, billing and marketing create inconsistent experiences and missed cross-sell.
agents.so: Deterministic and probabilistic identity resolution, golden-record creation, stewardship automation, CDP activation, and consent & privacy management.
agents.ou: 30–40% better data quality, 20–25% higher campaign conversion, 50% fewer data-error complaints.

agents.desc: Monitors BSS/OSS infrastructure, predicts failures, performs root-cause analysis, and executes self-healing remediation across IT and network.
agents.ch: The IT systems behind BSS/OSS are complex, distributed, and outage-prone.
agents.so: Proactive incident detection, cross-domain root-cause analysis, autonomous remediation, change-management automation, and service-desk automation on a unified AIOps plane.
agents.ou: 50–70% fewer IT incidents, 60–80% faster MTTR, 40% lower IT operations cost.

agents.desc: Connects 100+ legacy systems through TM Forum Open APIs and MCP adapters, builds a semantic integration layer, and guides modernisation to ODA.
agents.ch: Operators run 100+ legacy systems with fragile point-to-point integrations that slow innovation.
agents.so: API orchestration, MCP adapters for legacy, a semantic integration layer, governed AI execution, ODA modernisation guidance, and continuous integration monitoring.
agents.ou: 50% faster integration projects, 40% less technical debt, 3× more agents deployed.

fns.d: Runs build, test and deploy pipelines

agents.desc: Automates CI/CD, provisions infrastructure as code, instruments observability, scans for vulnerabilities, and manages safe feature rollouts.
agents.ch: Slow releases, manual deployments and inconsistent environments delay agent rollouts.
agents.so: CI/CD automation, infrastructure as code, observability, security & compliance scanning, and feature-flag management with automated rollback.
agents.ou: 70% faster release cycles, 50% fewer production incidents, 60% fewer deployment failures.

fns.d: Maintains a single KPI source of truth

agents.desc: Generates reports automatically, answers plain-English questions with visualisations, detects KPI anomalies, and produces predictive forecasts.
agents.ch: Executives struggle to access timely insight through fragmented tools and manual prep.
agents.so: Automated report generation, natural-language querying, anomaly detection, predictive analytics, and self-service dashboards.
agents.ou: 80% less report-generation time, 3× more data-driven decisions, 50% faster time-to-insight.

useCases.ch: 40% of contact-centre calls are billing disputes needing manual investigation across 5+ systems.
useCases.so: Centralises billing data, correlates usage records, identifies rating errors, and writes plain-language explanations for customers.

useCases.ch: B2B teams spend 60% of their time on unqualified leads and repetitive product questions.
useCases.so: Engages visitors, answers technical BSS/AAA questions, qualifies on firmographics and intent, and books AE meetings.

useCases.ch: Generic mass-market campaigns deliver <5% conversion and high discount costs.
useCases.so: Segments on real-time usage, spend and lifecycle data, then delivers personalised recharge offers by propensity to buy.

useCases.ch: Roaming fraud losses exceed $5M annually, with detection taking 24–48 hours.
useCases.so: Monitors roaming traffic in real time, detects suspicious usage, and blocks fraudulent SIMs within milliseconds.

useCases.ch: Leakage from unbilled usage and rating errors costs 2% of annual revenue.
useCases.so: Continuously cross-references switch, billing and usage pipelines, correcting leakages above $10K per cycle.

useCases.ch: Campaigns deliver inconsistent ROI from generic offers and poor timing.
useCases.so: Agents "bid" in real-time auctions for the right to present offers, optimising for conversion probability and lifetime value.

useCases.ch: Static plan pricing fails to capture willingness-to-pay across segments and time.
useCases.so: Adjusts plan prices, bundles and promotions in real time on demand forecasting, competitor moves and inventory.

useCases.ch: Internal IT and HR teams are overwhelmed by repetitive employee requests.
useCases.so: Handles most queries via chat, integrating with HRIS, ITSM and procurement to fulfil requests autonomously.

adaptations.desc: Auction every retention and growth offer in real time to the highest-intent segment.
Continuously reprice plans, bundles and add-ons to real willingness-to-pay.
Optimise total revenue across connectivity, content and services as one basket.
Recommend the next best offer and action for every subscriber, continuously.
Embed personalised financial products and BNPL into the telco relationship.
Run inventory-aware device promotions and flash sales that clear stock profitably.
Package content and connectivity into personalised media bundles.
Price QoS tiers dynamically to balance demand and monetise the network.

metrics.name: Cost per resolved contact
metrics.definition: Total scoped service cost divided by resolved contacts; relative reduction versus the same channel mix and baseline period.
metrics.context: Illustrative KPI target. Agree the target during discovery against the operator's baseline and validate in a scoped pilot; not an achieved result, forecast or guarantee.

metrics.name: Sales cycle duration
metrics.definition: Median days from accepted qualified lead to signed contract for comparable products; relative reduction versus the operator baseline.
metrics.context: Illustrative KPI target. Agree the target during discovery against the operator's baseline and validate in a scoped pilot; not an achieved result, forecast or guarantee.

metrics.name: Subscriber churn rate
metrics.definition: Subscribers leaving in the measurement period divided by subscribers at period start; relative reduction versus a comparable untreated cohort.
metrics.context: Illustrative KPI target. Agree the target during discovery against the operator's baseline and validate in a scoped pilot; not an achieved result, forecast or guarantee.

metrics.name: Disputes resolved within approved authority
metrics.definition: Disputes fully resolved without repeat contact in the agreed observation window divided by eligible disputes; approval-required decisions remain excluded.
metrics.context: Metric definition is proposed for discovery. The supplied figure is withheld pending clarification of baseline, scope and measurement.

metrics.name: Manual data-entry effort
metrics.definition: Staff minutes spent entering scoped records at matched volume and accuracy; relative reduction versus operator baseline.
metrics.context: Illustrative KPI target. Agree the target during discovery against the operator's baseline and validate in a scoped pilot; not an achieved result, forecast or guarantee.

metrics.name: Digital sales completions
metrics.definition: Completed digital purchases in matched periods, with cancellations and channel displacement reported separately; relative increase versus baseline.
metrics.context: Illustrative KPI target. Agree the target during discovery against the operator's baseline and validate in a scoped pilot; not an achieved result, forecast or guarantee.

metrics.name: Confirmed revenue leakage rate
metrics.definition: Confirmed unbilled or misrated eligible usage value divided by total eligible usage value; relative reduction versus operator baseline, excluding fraud overlap.
metrics.context: Illustrative KPI target. Agree the target during discovery against the operator's baseline and validate in a scoped pilot; not an achieved result, forecast or guarantee.

metrics.name: Confirmed fraud loss rate
metrics.definition: Confirmed fraud losses net of recovery divided by scoped revenue, with false positives and customer harm reported separately; relative reduction.
metrics.context: Illustrative KPI target. Agree the target during discovery against the operator's baseline and validate in a scoped pilot; not an achieved result, forecast or guarantee.

metrics.name: Net Promoter Score
metrics.definition: Percentage of promoters minus percentage of detractors on the same survey population. Changes are percentage points, not relative percent.
metrics.context: Metric definition is proposed for discovery. The supplied figure is withheld pending clarification of baseline, scope and measurement.

metrics.name: Roaming settlement duration
metrics.definition: Median elapsed time from period close to agreed settlement for comparable partners; relative reduction versus operator baseline.
metrics.context: Illustrative KPI target. Agree the target during discovery against the operator's baseline and validate in a scoped pilot; not an achieved result, forecast or guarantee.

metrics.name: Wholesale billing dispute rate
metrics.definition: Disputed invoices divided by invoices issued in comparable periods and partner scope; relative reduction.
metrics.context: Illustrative KPI target. Agree the target during discovery against the operator's baseline and validate in a scoped pilot; not an achieved result, forecast or guarantee.

metrics.name: Bad debt rate
metrics.definition: Written-off receivables divided by billed revenue for matched cohorts and observation windows; relative reduction, monitored alongside fairness and hardship outcomes.
metrics.context: Illustrative KPI target. Agree the target during discovery against the operator's baseline and validate in a scoped pilot; not an achieved result, forecast or guarantee.

metrics.name: Time to approved insight
metrics.definition: Median elapsed time from accepted analytical request to validated result at matched complexity; relative reduction.
metrics.context: Illustrative KPI target. Agree the target during discovery against the operator's baseline and validate in a scoped pilot; not an achieved result, forecast or guarantee.

metrics.name: Customer record quality
metrics.definition: Share of sampled records passing agreed completeness, accuracy and uniqueness checks; no compound quality score without agreed weights.
metrics.context: Metric definition is proposed for discovery. The supplied figure is withheld pending clarification of baseline, scope and measurement.

metrics.name: IT service restoration time
metrics.definition: Median elapsed time from confirmed scoped IT incident to verified service restoration; relative reduction, excluding network control.
metrics.context: Illustrative KPI target. Agree the target during discovery against the operator's baseline and validate in a scoped pilot; not an achieved result, forecast or guarantee.

metrics.name: Integration delivery duration
metrics.definition: Median elapsed time from approved interface design to accepted integration at matched complexity; relative reduction.
metrics.context: Illustrative KPI target. Agree the target during discovery against the operator's baseline and validate in a scoped pilot; not an achieved result, forecast or guarantee.

metrics.name: Release cycle duration
metrics.definition: Median elapsed time from approved change to verified release for comparable change classes; relative reduction with failure rate held within agreed limits.
metrics.context: Illustrative KPI target. Agree the target during discovery against the operator's baseline and validate in a scoped pilot; not an achieved result, forecast or guarantee.

metrics.name: Report preparation effort
metrics.definition: Staff minutes from available approved data to checked report at matched scope and quality; relative reduction.
metrics.context: Illustrative KPI target. Agree the target during discovery against the operator's baseline and validate in a scoped pilot; not an achieved result, forecast or guarantee.

metrics.name: Offer conversion rate
metrics.definition: Accepted eligible offers divided by delivered eligible offers within an agreed attribution window. Absolute rate and relative uplift are different measurements.
metrics.context: Metric definition is proposed for discovery. The supplied figure is withheld pending clarification of baseline, scope and measurement.

metrics.name: Lead-to-meeting conversion
metrics.definition: Qualified meetings held divided by eligible leads contacted in an agreed cohort. Supplied multiple needs baseline and qualification consistency.
metrics.context: Metric definition is proposed for discovery. The supplied figure is withheld pending clarification of baseline, scope and measurement.

metrics.name: Verified recovered revenue
metrics.definition: Revenue actually recovered, net of recovery costs and reversals, in a defined operator and billing period. No universal monetary promise.
metrics.context: Metric definition is proposed for discovery. The supplied figure is withheld pending clarification of baseline, scope and measurement.

metrics.name: Average revenue per user
metrics.definition: Scoped recognised service revenue divided by average active subscribers in a matched period; relative increase, controlling mix and tariff effects.
metrics.context: Illustrative KPI target. Agree the target during discovery against the operator's baseline and validate in a scoped pilot; not an achieved result, forecast or guarantee.

metrics.name: Bundle attachment rate
metrics.definition: Eligible customers adding the specified bundle divided by customers offered it in an agreed period; relative increase versus baseline.
metrics.context: Illustrative KPI target. Agree the target during discovery against the operator's baseline and validate in a scoped pilot; not an achieved result, forecast or guarantee.

metrics.name: Device inventory carrying cost
metrics.definition: Carrying cost for matched inventory volume and service availability over the agreed period; relative reduction.
metrics.context: Illustrative KPI target. Agree the target during discovery against the operator's baseline and validate in a scoped pilot; not an achieved result, forecast or guarantee.

metrics.name: Employee query resolution
metrics.definition: Eligible employee queries fully resolved with verified answers and no repeat contact in the agreed window divided by eligible queries.
metrics.context: Metric definition is proposed for discovery. The supplied figure is withheld pending clarification of baseline, scope and measurement.

metrics.name: RA/fraud case resolution duration
metrics.definition: Median time from validated alert to verified closure, reported separately for revenue leakage and fraud cases.
metrics.context: Metric definition is proposed for discovery. The supplied figure is withheld pending clarification of baseline, scope and measurement.

metrics.name: RA/fraud operating cost
metrics.definition: Cost of the scoped control process per reviewed case, with accuracy and customer-harm guardrails.
metrics.context: Metric definition is proposed for discovery. The supplied figure is withheld pending clarification of baseline, scope and measurement.

policy: Original numbers not present in classified metrics remain unresolved. No reported outcomes substantiated; all public figures are illustrative targets. Original source inventories are private review material, not public proof.
